best_player_distance_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vi_1 %>%
  spread_draws(r_primary_defender[primary_defender,], r_defense_distance_category[category,]) %>%
  # Calculate the combined effect for each player and distance category
  mutate(combined_effect = r_primary_defender + r_defense_distance_category) %>%
  # Get summary statistics
  group_by(primary_defender, category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_effect = mean(combined_effect),
    lower_95 = quantile(combined_effect, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(combined_effect, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  # Get top players by overall effectiveness
  group_by(primary_defender) %>%
  mutate(overall_effect = mean(mean_effect)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(overall_effect)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  # Create the plot
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_effect, y = reorder(primary_defender, overall_effect))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = category), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95, color = category), height = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Defenders",
    subtitle = "Most effective at preventing shot success",
    x = "Defensive Effect (log-odds)",
    y = "Player",
    color = "Defense Distance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  xlim(-2, 2)
